home.heroTitle:
Druid Forge
Web Solutions in Split
home.heroLead: We design and build websites, web apps and mobile apps for companies in Croatia, Germany and further afield. Every project starts with structure and content, not with a template.

process.step1Body: An hour on what you're building and who it's for. We don't send a quote until we understand the problem.
process.step2Body: Structure, content and scope on paper. Price and deadline are agreed here.
process.step3Body: Design and code run in parallel. Every week you get a link showing exactly where the work stands.
process.step4Body: Launch, analytics and a short handover session. The documentation stays with you.

home.ctaBody: Send a few sentences about what you need. We come back within one working day, either with questions or with a suggested next step.

services.indexLead: Six services, from websites and apps to business cards and flyers. The prices listed are starting points and depend on scope. You get the exact figure after a short conversation.
services.ctaBody: The price shown is a starting point. Send a few sentences about the project and we'll come back with a scope estimate and a price range.
services.indexCtaTitle: Not sure which one you need?
services.indexCtaBody: Tell us briefly what you do and what you want to achieve. We'll suggest which services make sense and which you can skip.

websites.name: Website design
websites.short: Fast, readable sites that search engines understand.
websites.description: Marketing sites for companies, sole traders and restaurants. We handle structure, copy, design and code. The site loads fast, works properly on a phone, and is ready for search engines on launch day.
websites.metaDescription: Custom website design for businesses in Split and beyond. Fast, SEO-ready sites from €700, live in 2–4 weeks.
included: Up to four pages, structured around what you sell
SEO plan, structured data and Google indexing
Copy written for you, or yours put in place
Cookie banner and the legal pages you need

webApps.name: Web applications
webApps.short: Tools that take over the manual work.
webApps.description: Custom web applications: booking systems, internal tools, client portals and dashboards. Before any code is written we map the workflow you already run, so the application follows your real process. Built on Next.js and PostgreSQL, with user accounts, roles and a record of every change.
webApps.metaDescription: Custom web application development: booking systems, portals, dashboards. Built on Next.js, from €2,500.
included: Integrations with systems you already run
Automated tests on the critical paths

mobileApps.name: Mobile applications
mobileApps.short: One codebase for iOS and Android.
mobileApps.description: Mobile applications for iOS and Android, published to the App Store and Google Play. We build in React Native from a single codebase, so fixes and new versions are done once for both platforms. Offline use, push notifications and in-app payments are added when the product calls for them. We publish to the App Store through our Apple developer account. If you would rather hold the account yourself, we set that up at the start.
mobileApps.metaDescription: Mobile app development for iOS and Android: React Native, offline support, push notifications. From €4,000.
included: App Store and Google Play submission

weddingInvites.name: Digital wedding invitations
weddingInvites.short: An invitation that lives on a link, not in an envelope.
weddingInvites.description: An invitation that lives on a link: your story, the schedule, a venue map and a gift list on one page guests open on their phone. Pick a template we fill with your details, or an invitation drawn from scratch for your day. The RSVP form comes as an add-on, and €80 covers another 12 months from a start date you choose.
weddingInvites.metaDescription: Digital wedding invitations: a template from €18, fully custom from €180. Your story, the schedule, a venue map and RSVPs.

template.name: Template invitation
template.description: You pick one of our templates and we fill it with your names, the date, the schedule and your photographs. Colours and type are matched to your theme, and everything else is already built and tested, so the invitation is online in a day or two.
included: A template of your choice from our gallery
Your names, the date and a countdown to the day
Your photographs in the places the template makes room for
Colours and type matched to your theme
A link ready to send on WhatsApp and Viber
Page online from a month before the wedding to a week after
template.note: The template gallery is still being built. Until it is up, ask and we'll send the ones that are finished. The RSVP form, a second language and a custom domain are available as add-ons.

custom.name: Custom invitation
custom.description: We draw the invitation from an empty page around your theme, your colours and your story. The animated opening, the order of the sections and the details like the countdown and the gift list follow your day rather than a template.
included: Design and an animated opening in your theme and colours
Your story, a gift list and a countdown to the day
An address with your names, custom domain extra
Page online from a month before the wedding to a week after
custom.note: The price covers the design and build of one invitation in two languages. The RSVP form and a custom domain are add-ons.

businessCards.name: Business card design
businessCards.short: A card that survives the drawer.
businessCards.description: Business card design with print-ready artwork. We handle the typography and layout, and recommend the stock and finish that suit it: emboss, foil or a painted edge. You get files any printer can use.
businessCards.metaDescription: Business card design, print-ready: typography, stock and finish handled. From €70, ready in 2–3 days.
included: A digital version for your email signature

flyers.name: Flyer design
flyers.description: Flyers, posters and brochures for events, offers and openings. We set the hierarchy so the main message reads from three metres away and the detail reads up close. If you don't have the copy, we write it.
flyers.metaDescription: Flyer and poster design for events, offers and openings: clear hierarchy, print-ready. From €80.
included: Concept and copy if you need it
Every format from A6 to A3
Artwork for print and for web

about.title: A small studio in Split
about.lead: Two brothers in Split. We both write code and we both talk to clients, so reach whichever of us you like.
about.storyBody: A druid's knowledge comes from practice, not from a book. A forge turns raw metal into a tool for one particular hand. The name joins the two, and so do we: whoever knows the material makes the call.

duje.name: Duje Milić
duje.bio: At a computer for as long as he can remember. He wrote his first code as a kid, and the habit turned into the job.

dominko.name: Dominko Milić
dominko.bio: Coding since his teens, when he started making games instead of playing them. The same curiosity still drives him.

values.directBody: Write to either of us. Whoever answers leads the project, and the other one works on the code.
values.ownBody: The code and design are yours from day one. You get the source files when the project ends.
values.plainBody: Scope and price are agreed before we start. If the scope changes, you hear about it before we do the work.

about.locationBody: Split, Croatia. Our clients are mainly in Croatia and Germany, but we work with businesses anywhere. Meetings in person in Split, everything else online.
about.ctaTitle: Call, and one of us picks up
about.ctaBody: Reach either of us. We reply within one working day.

cookies.bannerBody: Necessary cookies keep the site working. Analytics and ad measurement need your consent. You can withdraw it at any time.
cookies.prefDescription: Choose which categories you allow. Necessary cookies cannot be switched off, because the site does not work without them.
cookies.necessaryBody: They remember your language and your cookie choice, and protect the contact form from abuse. The site does not work correctly without them.
cookies.analyticsBody: We use Google Analytics to count visits and show which pages people read. The data is aggregated and is not used to identify individuals.
cookies.adsBody: We use Google Ads to tell whether a visit came from one of our ads and whether it ended in a form submission. This measures how the ads perform; the content of your message is never sent to Google.
cookies.ccCookie: Remembers which cookie categories you allowed.
cookies.analyticsId: Google Analytics — distinguishes visitors in aggregate statistics, without name or email.
cookies.analyticsSession: Google Analytics — remembers how long a visit lasted and how you arrived at the site.
cookies.adsLinker: Google Ads — links an ad click to a form submission on this site.
cookies.adsClick: Google Ads — remembers the identifier of the ad click that brought you to the site.
cookies.adsTestCookie: Google Ads — checks whether your browser supports cookies.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains which personal data {legalName} collects, why it collects it, and what rights you have under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
privacy.s1Body: The controller is {legalName}, {street}, {postalCode} {city}, Croatia, VAT ID {vatId}. For any data protection question write to {email}.
privacy.s2Body: We collect only what you send through the contact form: your name, email address, optionally a company name, the service you selected, a rough budget and your message. We also record technical data needed for security — your IP address and the time the form was submitted.
privacy.s3Body: We process form data to answer your enquiry and prepare a quote. The legal basis is your consent, and taking steps at your request before entering a contract. Technical data is processed on the basis of our legitimate interest in protecting the site from abuse.
privacy.s4Body: Enquiries that do not lead to work are deleted after 12 months. Client data is kept for the duration of the contract and a further 11 years for invoices, as required by Croatian tax law. Security logs are deleted after 30 days.
privacy.s5Body: We do not sell your data or pass it to third parties for their own purposes. We use processors for hosting and email delivery, who process data only on our instructions and within the European Economic Area, or under standard contractual clauses where a transfer outside it is necessary. With your cookie consent, we also use Google Analytics for visit statistics and Google Ads to measure how our ads perform. Google Ads only learns that a visit ended in a form submission — not the content of your message or your contact details.
privacy.s6Body: You have the right to access your data, correct inaccurate data, have it deleted, restrict processing, receive it in a portable format, and object to processing. You can withdraw consent at any time, without affecting the lawfulness of processing before withdrawal. Send requests to {email} and we respond within 30 days.
privacy.s7Body: If you believe we process your data unlawfully, you can complain to the Croatian Personal Data Protection Agency (AZOP), Selska cesta 136, 10000 Zagreb, azop.hr.
privacy.s8Body: This site uses cookies. Details and consent controls are in the cookie policy.
privacy.s9Body: We update this policy when the way we process data changes. The date of the last change is shown at the top of the page.

cookiePolicy.title: Cookie policy
cookiePolicy.intro: Cookies are small files a site stores in your browser. This page lists which ones we use, what they do, and how you change your choice.
cookiePolicy.s1Body: On your first visit you choose which categories to allow. You can change that at any time using the button below or the “Cookie settings” link in the footer.
cookiePolicy.s2Body: Necessary cookies are always on, because the site does not work without them. Analytics is yours to switch on.
cookiePolicy.s3Body: This list is updated whenever we add or remove a tool.
cookiePolicy.s4Body: You can also delete and block cookies in your browser settings. If you block all cookies, parts of the site will stop working correctly — remembering your language, for instance.

notFound.title: This page went back in the fire
notFound.body: Metal that will not hold its shape goes back to the forge and gets worked again. This link is probably out of date, or the address has a typo in it.
notFound.hint: If a link on our own site sent you here, tell us and we will fix it.

error.title: The hammer slipped
error.body: This one is on us, not on you, and it has already been logged. Refreshing the page usually sorts it.
error.hint: If it keeps happening, send us the code below at {email} and we will look into it.
